meta.title: About Our Community — By Aurum Girls
meta.description: The story of By Aurum Girls: a socio-economic community project bringing together artisan women in Caucasus mountain villages.

hero.title: The Strength and Love of Our Rural Women
hero.subtitle: We are a community project that brings together artisan women living in mountain villages and delivers their handiwork straight to your table.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Aurum Girls Eco-Tourism enterprise is an innovative space that brings together education, women's development, entrepreneurship, rural life, and eco-tourism. The company organizes various training sessions, practical workshops and educational programs for women, young people and members of the local community. These activities help participants gain new knowledge and skills, expand their entrepreneurial opportunities and apply what they learn in practice.
story.paragraph2: At the same time, Aurum Girls offers visitors the opportunity to experience rural life, participate in the cultivation and preparation of local products, connect more closely with nature, and discover the cultural values of the region.
story.paragraph3: Guests can learn about local agricultural products, take part in tastings and masterclasses, and gain hands-on experience related to agriculture and environmentally friendly lifestyles.
story.paragraph4: One of the main goals of Aurum Girls is to strengthen the economic opportunities of local women, develop their entrepreneurial skills, and improve market access for locally produced goods.
story.paragraph5: For us, Aurum Girls is more than a tourism destination. It is a platform for learning, creating, gaining practical experience, connecting with nature and contributing to the development of the local community.

missionVision.missionText: To honor the traditional skills of our rural women by giving them fair income and economic independence, while delivering 100% natural food products free of chemical additives to you.
missionVision.visionText: A future where women's communities in every mountain village of Azerbaijan are recognized and supported through their own products — where traditions are preserved and nature is respected.

artisans.title: Our Artisans
artisans.subtitle: Behind every category stand our rural women, working with years of experience and love.
artisans.role1Text: Our women who tend beehives in the mountain pastures and produce pure, strained honey each season.
artisans.role2Text: Our artisans who hand-pick wild forest berries and turn them into jam using traditional village methods.
artisans.role3Text: Our women who hand-pick and dry thyme, yellow flower, and mountain herbs at just the right season.

cta.title: Taste the Difference
cta.subtitle: Discover the rich taste of natural mountain honey, jam, and teas handcrafted by our rural women.
